articles.title: Early release scheme could see dangerous criminals released, Conservatives warn
articles.description: Nick Timothy's comments follow an announcement from the prime minister that some prisoners serving indefinite sentences could be freed to increase prison capacity.

articles.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
articles.description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

articles.title: Patel to be replaced by Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary
articles.description: Kemi Badenoch is expected to carry out a wider reshuffle of her front bench team following high-profile departures.

articles.title: Djokovic in tears during US Open first-round exit
articles.description: An emotional Novak Djokovic suffers a US Open first-round defeat which provides further evidence that age is catching up with the 39-year-old great.
